# gitea_repository_tag (Resource)

This resource manages git tags in a Gitea repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitea_repository_tag" "example" {
  user    = "my-org"
  repo    = "my-repo"
  name    = "v1.0.0"
  target  = "main"
  message = "Tagging release v1.0.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name
- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Optional

- `message` (String) Tag message for annotated tags
- `target` (String) Target commit SHA or branch name (defaults to default branch)

### Read-Only

- `commit_sha` (String) The SHA of the commit that the tag points to
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Using `import` blocks in Terraform v1.5.0 and later:
# import {
#   to = gitea_repository_tag.example
#   id = "<user>/<repo>/<tag_name>"
# }

# Using `terraform import` in Terraform v1.4.0 and earlier:
terraform import gitea_repository_tag.example <user>/<repo>/<tag_name>
```
